Name: CategorizedChests
Author: xw025
Description:
# Categorized Chests
Categorized Chests turns every chest into a smart, category-aware container. Instead of digging through a 36-slot mess, you get a filter bar that lets you view and move one kind of item at a time — and chests can be labeled with a category so your items are stored in the right place automatically.

## Features
Category tabs A filter bar sits between the chest grid and your inventory, with 21 categories plus an All tab: Seeds, Vegetables, Fruit, Flowers, Fish, Animal Products, Minerals, Artifacts, Resources, Forage, Cooking, Artisan Goods, Crafting, Fertilizer, Trash, Fishing Tackle, Decor, Furniture, Books, Equipment, and Trinkets. Items that don't match the active tab are dimmed and can't be clicked, so the chest visually narrows down to just what you need. Each tab shows a representative item icon.

Labeled chests Click a tab to save that category on the chest. Once a chest has a label, you can press the green Store button under your inventory to deposit every matching item from your backpack in one go, and the blue Take button to pull every stored item of that category back out.

Smart depositing When you store items, nearby labeled chests are checked first — the chest you have open is always considered last. Each item is routed by matching, in order: the chest's exact category, the category's precise rules, then the game's own item type name. Nothing lands in the wrong chest just because two categories overlap.

Favorites stay with you Hold Alt and left-click any item in your inventory to favorite it — it gets a gold diamond marker. Favorited items are never auto-stored by this mod, and the rule is enforced at the chest level, so they stay in your backpack no matter how you try to put them away (including the shipping bin and fridge).

Works with modded items Classification walks through the vanilla item type, the numeric category, the qualified type prefix (weapons, tools, hats, boots, shirts, pants, rings, trinkets, furniture, wallpaper, flooring), furniture placement restrictions, the game's localized item type name, context tags, and finally name keywords. Modded items that follow vanilla conventions are categorized automatically, no patch required.

Fully configurable Every rule lives in`config.json` : categories, category IDs, numeric categories, item type prefixes, object types, furniture restrictions, context tags, name keywords, icons, and display names. Your default rule set upgrades automatically when the mod updates — custom names, icons, and added keywords are preserved, and your own categories are appended at the end.

## How to use
1. Install SMAPI 4.x and Stardew Valley 1.6.
2. Drop the`CategorizedChests` folder into your`Mods` directory.
3. Open any chest — the tab bar appears between the two grids.
4. Click a tab to filter and label the chest, then use Store / Take to move items in bulk.
5. Hold Alt and left-click items to mark favorites.
## Notes
- No new items, objects, or save data are added — the mod only adds UI and smart movement, so it's safe to install or remove at any time.
- Chest labels and favorite marks are stored in the chest/item`modData` , which the game already saves and syncs.
- The tab bar and all UI are rendered client-side. In multiplayer, each player needs the mod to see it; chest labels are saved by the host even if the host doesn't have the mod installed.
- Localization: English and Simplified Chinese are included.
## Compatibility
Built for Stardew Valley 1.6 and SMAPI 4.0+. Uses Harmony patches that are all wrapped in exception guards, so a failure in one feature never blocks the vanilla chest UI.
